title: Linear feature section
description: A product-area section under a full-width hairline: a 48px two-line title on the left, a 24px pale description and a grey 'Learn more →' on the right, then a wide product-window slot whose edges fade into the page, and a small 'Features' index of links with plus signs in two columns split by a vertical hairline. On phones the window comes first as a full-bleed band, cropped off the right edge, followed by the title and text.
notes: made to repeat: the page stacks four of these, one per product area
media: a product screenshot or video at ~2.36:1 (390×312 band on phones); empty, a bordered placeholder panel
the feature index is hidden on phones, as on the original
